parsed.internal_thinking: Ziv is offering 1 Wheat for 1 Brick. I currently have 1 Brick, 2 Wheat, and 2 Sheep. My goal is to build a settlement on Node 14, which requires 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I already have the Brick, Wheat, and Sheep needed for that settlement; I only lack the Wood. If I accept this trade, I will lose the Brick I need and gain a third Wheat, which doesn't help me progress toward my settlement and actually puts me further away by requiring me to find another Brick. Furthermore, Ziv has good production and I shouldn't help him unless it significantly benefits me. Therefore, I will reject the trade.
parsed.note_to_self: Ziv is looking for bricks. I need to hold onto mine for the settlement at Node 14. I still need 1 Wood to complete the requirements for that settlement.
parsed.say_outloud: מצטערת זיו, אני חייבת לשמור את הלבנה הזאת ליישוב הבא שלי. אני ממש קרובה לבנות אותו.
